speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To begin our assessment, how many days old are you, and is this jaundice visible in the first 24 hours of life?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated jaundice (physiologic jaundice with inadequate intake). The history of exclusive breastfeeding, 2-week age of onset, and stable weight gain are consistent with this condition. No further tests are required unless clinical signs of dehydration or failure to thrive develop.
